1709.Title: Investment Product Analyst, Multi-Asset
1709.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Investment Product Analyst, Multi-Asset

 

About Us

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.
 

Job Summary:

 

Both Multi-Asset and Asia are seen as key elements of Schroders’ strategy for growth. The Product Management team is part of the overall Multi-Asset team, but takes responsibility for managing the business of Multi-Asset, allowing the fund managers to focus on investing. It provides a bridge between the investment team and distribution helping to support and grow Multi-Asset business. The team is also the main point of contact with the marketing and product development teams. The team is involved in a wide range of activities that includes proactively engaging with clients on performance, positioning, and market outlook in addition to client reporting and servicing, new pitches and being the experts to whom the rest of Schroders will revert for enquiries on the products and services of Multi-Asset. The Investment Product Analysts role is based in Hong Kong and will cover the North Asia region.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

The role is based in Hong Kong and will cover North Asia clients primarily.

 

The primary responsibilities focus on:

 

(a) Product and Client Support

 

•    Client reports and review presentations – Provide regular updates of market and portfolio performance, as well as portfolio investment strategy, for distribution to existing clients.

•    Product material — Ensure all regular Multi-Asset product presentations and fund updates are produced for distribution to sales channels.

•    Product profiles – Maintain detailed specifications for each product, and take the lead in devising content for marketing literature for sales channels.

•    Ad hoc reporting — Support sales and client service teams in responding to client queries.

•    Language – Mandarin speaking and writing is highly preferred

 

(b) New Business Development

 

•    RFP ownership — Ensure RFPs are completed with the highest standards possible and tailored to clients' needs.

•    Client Pitches — Assist in the development of presentations for client pitches.

•    Product Map and pitch books — Maintain and regularly update Multi-Asset product map and product pitch books.

 

(c) Business Management

 

•    New business support – Maintain and analyse AUM, fund flows and business profitability relating to the Asian Multi-Asset investment desk.

2189.Title: Implementation Portfolio Manager, Asian Equities
2189.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Job Title: Implementation Portfolio Manager (Asian Equities)

About Us
Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.

Job Summary:

We aim to successfully assist in the management and implementation of a portfolio’s investment strategy. 


Implementation Portfolio Managers take responsibility for implementation of investment decisions and trades, working closely with Head of Portfolio Implementation and Investment Teams to design and propose the investment implementation and pre-trade compliance monitoring process.  In some teams they are also responsible for overseeing cash management, and corporate actions.


An Implementation Portfolio Manager’s main stakeholder is the Investment team; however as a senior team member he/ she is also expected to be able to manage and navigate more complex queries by representing the Investment Team in providing the support link between Investment Product, Operations & Client Group teams.  A good Implementation Portfolio Manager has to be able to meet the following criteria. 
1.    At least 7 years in portfolio implementation relevant experience

2.    Have the support and trust of Investment colleagues when conducting the day-to-day as well as any ad-hoc investment implementation 
3.    Have good knowledge of operational processes, business and market requirements.
4.    Have a good understanding of guidelines and regulations of mandates and funds managed by the investment desk
5.    Possess strong knowledge of regulations and execution processes for all markets included in desk strategies. 
6.    Well versed in the Group’s policies and processes, including for e.g. the Risk Event Reporting procedures

7.    Have sufficient proficiency in Mandarin and written Chinese to review and interpret Chinese-language documentation and regulatory requirements

Key Responsibilities:

Key Activities
•    Designing and proposing procedures for implementation, pre-trade compliance monitoring and portfolio management 
•    Trade authorisation (for Time Deposit and Unit Trust Only)
•    Day to day Portfolio oversight
•    Cash management & hedging 
•    Transition management activities and fund restructuring 
•    Risk Management using derivatives
•    Drift management of portfolio positions
•    Liquidity Monitoring
•    Coordinate Transaction Cost Analysis (TCA) with Dealing team
•    Delivery of on-desk training (systems and processes)

Key Behaviours For Success

•    Attention to detail – granular, detail-oriented with strong mathematical and technical skills 
•    Strong time management

2143.Title: 2027 Sales Internship Programme (HK)
2143.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Job title: Intern  Department: Sales (within Client Group) Start date: Monday 14 June 2027

Location: Hong Kong 

 

About Us

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.

 

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.

Programme overview:

Our 2027 Hong Kong Summer Internship Programme runs for 10 weeks, starting on Monday 14 June 2027 and finishing on Friday 20 August 2027. This internship is designed to give you a unique introduction to the asset and wealth management industry and offers valuable insight into how your chosen department operates within Schroders.

 

Throughout the programme you will:

 

  • Take part in comprehensive introductory training to build your understanding of the business

  • Be assigned to a team where you will contribute to live projects and gain meaningful hands-on experience

  • Shadow experienced professionals and learn directly from leaders in the field

  • Have opportunities to network with colleagues and other interns, helping you build connections for your future career

 

This internship provides practical experience, skill development, and a strong foundation for those interested in pursuing a career in the asset and wealth management industry.

 

Who we’re looking for:

We’re seeking driven and client-focused individuals who are passionate about asset management and eager to contribute to a high-performing, collaborative team. The ideal candidate will have a genuine interest in financial markets, a commercial mindset, and the ability to build strong relationships with both colleagues and clients. You should be proactive, adaptable, and comfortable communicating with a variety of stakeholders, including senior professionals and external clients. If you thrive in dynamic environments, enjoy problem-solving, and are keen to make a tangible impact, we would like to hear from you.
